sections.title: charaNam 1
lyrics: anudinamum yEndhan vAkkil unnAmam - adhuvallAl matrOndrum illayE yannEmam
manakkavalaiyai theerka marudhaivam unnai paarka - yanakkundO unakkErka irangi un kaNpArka
charaNam 2 - Adhi shakthiyanru pErEduthAyE akhilamum - vardhikka avadharithAyE jAthakam pOl unnai
sharaNam pukundhEyannai Adharikka pinnai - yAr undu shOl annayE

sections.title: charanam 3
lyrics: kAmitha phalatthai kai mEl tharuvAyE - kaN pArthu rakshippadhu yEppodhum neeyE
sOmashEkarar pAdhi sundhari kaumAri - shyAma kRshNa sOdhari shaila rAja kumAri
